'''Gerba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. One of his employee, [[Viron Ghartoth]], presented him with [[Paralyngian dire slug]] in [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]]. Ghartoth was unaware that this would cause an allergic reaction in the Hutt, and from his sickbed Gerba ordered for Ghartoth to be slowly devoured by his captive [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]].<ref name="ETO" />
